messages:
elena: Hey team — draft of the launch blog for the new Dedicated tiers is up: https://docs.google.com/example (DO NOT PUBLISH yet). Need final copy, hero image, and benchmark callouts by EOD Fri. Also planning a short webinar next week; want blog + webinar CTAs aligned.

sam: Reading now. Quick ask — can we tighten the hero headline to focus on predictable throughput? Current headline feels generic.

jake: +1 on the headline. Also need to confirm the 95th percentile latency numbers with infra before we publish. I can ping eng-runtime.

maria: One legal note: any customer names or quotes in the draft need written opt-ins. I flagged the two inline quotes; if we don't have sign-off, we should replace with anonymized paraphrases.

noah: Uploading two hero options to the assets folder: /design/marketing/dedicated-heroes. Option A = cluster shot, Option B = operator at workstation. I prefer B for human signal.

elena: Thanks — Sam, can you try 3 headline variants (short) by noon tomorrow? Jake, please loop infra on the latency verification. Maria, noted — we'll remove or anonymize quotes if no opt-in by Thurs.

erin: On GTM — sales wants an inbound routing plan: blog -> gated webinar (recording) -> SDR follow-up for accounts hitting >100k tokens in trial. Can we add a hidden UTM that maps to SDR queue? Suggested tag: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch&utm_segment=high_usage`

sam: Drafted headlines: 1) "Predictable LLM Throughput, without the ops" 2) "Dedicated capacity for production-grade inference" 3) "Run LLMs at scale with predictable latency" My pick: 1. Shorten second paragraph to make room for benchmark bullet.

jake: Eng confirmed latency: 95th p50 p95 numbers attached in thread — use "p95 latency ~ 120 ms at 8k context on A100" (pending final QA). Use conservative phrasing: "typical p95 ~120 ms in our tests."

maria: Confirmed — that phrasing works. Also, we need to remove the two specific customer callouts unless we have written approval.

noah: Design note: for social cards we need a 1:1 crop. I'll export both hero options and a square variant by tomorrow morning.

elena: Editorial checklist for approvals: final headline (Marketing), benchmark phrasing (Eng sign-off), hero image (Design), legal sign-off on quotes (Legal). Can we aim to lock everything by Fri 5pm? If yes I'll set embargo and schedule publish for Tue 09:00 PT.

erin: Approve timeline. I'll coordinate with SDR lead to configure the inbound routing and update the playbook. Please add an internal slack mention for @sales when we publish.

sam: Two small edits in the doc: shorten CTA to "Try Dedicated — get predictable throughput" and move the how-it-works box below the benchmark bullets.

elena: Sounds good. I'll make those edits tonight. Who wants final review pass before I lock?

jake: I can do final numbers/QA on Friday morning.

maria: Legal can approve by EOD Friday if we remove unapproved quotes now.

noah: I'll drop the final hero files and social crops by 9am Fri.

elena: Great — thanks everyone. I'll set the Google doc permissions to comment-only and tag folks for the final pass. Embargo: publish blocked until Tue 09:00 PT; please do not share externally. :lock:  

publish-bot: Note: scheduled publish task created (placeholder) — waiting for final approval flags.

sam: LGTM (one nit on comma in the second paragraph).

erin: FYI I'll hold a 15m sync with SDR on Mon to confirm routing and follow-up templates.

elena: Final reminder: if you can't review by Fri EOD, call it out here now so we can move forward. Otherwise I'll assume sign-off cadence as discussed. :thumbsup:
